fullCurrentDE.title: Datenverteilungen mithilfe von Kenngrößen und Boxplots vergleichen und deuten
fullCurrentDE.description: Die lernende Person kann aus bekannten Kenngrößen und aus Boxplots Informationen über zugrunde liegende Datensätze gewinnen, vergleichende Aussagen formulieren und diese fachlich begründet beurteilen.

fullCurrentEN.title: Compare and interpret data distributions using indicators and box plots
fullCurrentEN.description: The learner can infer information about underlying data sets from known indicators and box plots, formulate comparative statements and evaluate them with mathematical justification.

Case2 reverses what favorable means: lower median delivery time is faster, but the other service has lower total range. EqualIQR is correctly retained. Neither imagehigherMedian nor smallerIQR becomes a universal better or a probability claim.

Case3, under its explicit median-excluding quartile convention, has identical five-number summaries yet different listed raw data and arithmetic means8versus70/9. Thus all individual values,frequencystructure,meananddistributionalshape are not generally determined. Counts and means are calculated from the supplied rawdata only, never reconstructed from the picture.
